newsitem.title: USA: PP&L Resources Inc Q4 profit slips.
newsitem.headline: PP&L Resources Inc Q4 profit slips.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Results exclude impact of weather variance.
1995 Q4 excludes a charge of $0.15 a share from the sale of Greene Hill Coal Co and a gain of $0.04 a share related to workforce reductions.
1996 year excludes a charge of $0.03 a share from research and experimentation income tax credits and a gain of $0.03 a share related to workforce reductions.

1995 year excludes charges of $0.13 a share from workforce reductions, $0.12 a share from the sale of Greene Hill Coal, SFAS 106 costs of $0.10 a share, and purchased power costs of $0.04 a share. 1995 year excludes a $0.13 a share gain from the disallowance of Susquehanna Unit number 1 window deferral.
